contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP CONSTANTINE P F AVG ; R/ MARTI PATRI PROPVGNATORI

A Roman Copper alloy nummus of Constantine I (AD 306-337), dating to AD 307-308 (Reece Period 15). MARTI PATRI PROPVGNATORI reverse type, depicting mars advancing right with transverse sceptre and shield on left arm. Minted in Trier. RIC VI, pg. 218, no. 777. Obverse inscription: IMP CONSTANTINE P F AVG. Reverse description: Mars advancing right with transverse sceptre and shield on left arm.…
